meta.title: DSH Toolbox
meta.description: Personal tool pack: two-layer memory injection + memory write tool, see_image (vision model transcription via host LLM channel), dispatch (assembles review-form combos and ready-made briefs per batch type; at stage 方案 it emits the plan task book; its rules live in JSON read fresh on every call; one exception: the enum in the parameter surface is a registration-time snapshot, so a new legal value needs a restart to enter that vocabulary), dispatch_batch (batch ledger with start/advance/status/list; state is folded from the events, the ledger lives in the machine-shared agent-data repo, and dispatch(batch=…) back-fills that batch's decision list), and dispatch_lessons (retro helper: reads the whole ledger and drafts pairing-rule revision suggestions once enough batches are logged — suggestions only, the main session decides and nothing is written back).
